1 // drivers/elegance-pass.mjs — the Elegance pass + Rabbit-Catcher pass, ONE module for the trio.
2 //
3 // John, 2026-09-05: "an elegance pass and a rabbit catcher pass that are run after the crucible
4 // plan gets built (along with an adversarial review of these). Then have an elegance and rabbit
5 // catcher review after each wave of foreman." Decision (John, same day): CUT verdicts BLOCK in
6 // Crucible (before anything is built) and in Foreman only when a SECOND seat confirms them.
7 //
8 // The criterion is ELEGANCE.md Part II (Skill Foundry root; the canonical text). The battery
9 // below is that text's per-element questions, compact, with the same verdicts. Two seats:
10 //   - the CATCHER runs the battery: the steering seat (role `synthesizer` → the dashboard's
11 //     coding family);
12 //   - the ADVERSARY attacks the verdicts: the review seat (role `shark` → the review family).
13 // Bounded by construction: one call each per hook, never recursive (a HOLD's investigation is
14 // not itself batteried). Everything the seats say is data; the engines apply verdicts.
15 //
16 // Provenance is not the seat's opinion. Every element's claimed need is tagged
17 //   `user-ratified` | `record` (a journal / incident / prior artifact) | `proposer-written` | `none`
18 // and a need whose only record is one the proposer wrote for this effort cannot earn KEEP
19 // (RC-1). The Foundry's own 2026-09-05 failure: a LITE run integrated 7/7 ideas, each "serving"
20 // a criterion the planner had written that morning (crucible journal 0094).
21 
22 /** The pass's own typed failure — a seat that returned no judgeable JSON. */
23 export class ElegancePassError extends Error {
24   constructor(message) { super(message); this.name = 'ElegancePassError'; }
25 }
26 
27 export const ELEGANCE_PASS_VERSION = 'elegance-pass/1 (ELEGANCE.md Part II, 2026-08-15; engine hooks 2026-09-05)';
28 
29 export const VERDICTS = Object.freeze(['KEEP', 'HOLD', 'CUT']);
30 export const PROVENANCE = Object.freeze(['user-ratified', 'record', 'proposer-written', 'none']);
31 
32 /** The battery, compact. The canonical text is ELEGANCE.md Part II; this must not drift from it. */
33 export const RC_BATTERY = `
34 RC-1 Needed-because, with an INDEPENDENT citable need: what forces this element, named as a record
35   independent of the element's proposer — it predates this effort, or carries the user's authorship
36   or ratification, or is an incident/journal record. A record created in order to justify the
37   element (by the proposer, in this effort) does not count; packaging an element beside a
38   legitimately-needed sibling transfers nothing. No independent need ⇒ presumptive ⇒ CUT or park.
39 RC-2 Delete-and-check, objective named: what breaks if this is removed, for WHOM, against WHICH
40   on-record objective. The only loss being an unexercised presumptive FEATURE ⇒ rabbit hole.
41   Carve-out: malleability work (tests, seams, refactors, design investment) is never "unexercised
42   capability" — IF it ships no user-facing behaviour nobody asked for AND names the next concrete
43   change it cheapens (a change that passes RC-1 itself).
44 RC-3 Leverage: what disproportionately large consequence does this buy, and what does it let us
45   DROP. A plan/process element that adds machinery while retiring none is presumed extraneous
46   (guards are scored by RC-G instead).
47 RC-4 Whose simplicity: does this move complexity onto the user or maintainer? Cutting intrinsic
48   complexity or interface-protecting depth is forbidden; only extraneous load is a target.
49 RC-5 Earned or premature, by written trigger: scaffolding is EARNED when it carries a written
50   retirement trigger; a simplification is premature when it precedes the understanding it claims.
51 RC-6 Critical path: does the locked North Star FAIL without this, or merely feel less complete?
52   When uncertain: PARK it (zero further spend) and carry one line to the user — never pursue silently.
53 RC-7 Tie-breaker only: elegance never overrides a requirement, a datum, or a failing test.
54 RC-8 Wave count (Stage 2 only): a wave is a change a reviewer would want to see alone. Adjacent
55   waves that are ONE change merge, on the record: a parser without its renderer is invisible, a
56   module without its hooks is dead code, a backend that exists only for one link ships with the
57   link, a wave whose gate needs the NEXT wave's change to be tested is the same change. Waves that
58   touch different failure surfaces, or bury an irreversible / externally visible step beside a safe
59   one, stay apart.
60 RC-G Guards (tests, gates, error handling, journals, run-records): forced by a NAMED hazard that
61   obeys the same independence law (predates the proposal, the user named it, or its class has
62   occurred on the record); the guard must actually SEE the failure it guards; its false-alarm cost
63   is stated. A guard that cannot see what the user sees is theater.
64 Disposition — exactly one verdict per element: KEEP (independent need, no failing question);
65   HOLD (something unresolved and NAMED: a written cure + retirement trigger, or an RC-6 uncertainty
66   parked for the user's one-line answer); CUT (no independent need, or a failing question with no
67   cure — logged, so the cut is on the record).`;
68 
69 /**
70  * Normalize elements to `{ id, text, kind }`. `kind` is 'element' | 'guard' | 'malleability'
71  * (tests/seams/refactors) — the seat may re-classify, but the caller's hint rides along.
72  */
73 export function normalizeElements(items) {
74   const out = [];
75   const list = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
76   list.forEach((it, i) => {
77     if (it === null || it === undefined) return;
78     if (typeof it === 'string') {
79       const t = it.trim();
80       if (t) out.push({ id: `E${i + 1}`, text: t, kind: 'element' });
81       return;
82     }
83     const text = String(it.text ?? it.title ?? '').trim();
84     if (!text) return;
85     out.push({
86       id: String(it.id ?? `E${i + 1}`),
87       text,
88       kind: ['element', 'guard', 'malleability'].includes(it.kind) ? it.kind : 'element',
89       ...(it.detail ? { detail: String(it.detail).slice(0, 1200) } : {}),
90     });
91   });
92   return out;
93 }
94 
95 const CATCHER_SCHEMA = {
96   type: 'object',
97   required: ['verdicts'],
98   properties: {
99     verdicts: {
100       type: 'array',
101       items: {
102         type: 'object',
103         required: ['id', 'verdict', 'need', 'provenance', 'rc2', 'needed_because'],
104         properties: {
105           id: { type: 'string' },
106           verdict: { type: 'string', enum: [...VERDICTS] },
107           need: { type: 'string' },
108           provenance: { type: 'string', enum: [...PROVENANCE] },
109           rc2: { type: 'string' },
110           trigger: { type: 'string' },
111           needed_because: { type: 'string' },
112           failing: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
113         },
114       },
115     },
116     nothing_cut_said_aloud: { type: 'boolean' },
117   },
118 };

120 const ADVERSARY_SCHEMA = {
121   type: 'object',
122   required: ['disputes'],
123   properties: {
124     disputes: {
125       type: 'array',
126       items: {
127         type: 'object',
128         required: ['id', 'disputed_verdict', 'reason', 'severity'],
129         properties: {
130           id: { type: 'string' },
131           disputed_verdict: { type: 'string', enum: [...VERDICTS] },
132           proposed_verdict: { type: 'string', enum: [...VERDICTS] },
133           reason: { type: 'string' },
134           severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['BLOCKER', 'MAJOR', 'MINOR'] },
135           trigger: { type: 'string' },
136         },
137       },
138     },
139   },
140 };

142 function provenanceBlock(provenance) {
143   const p = provenance && typeof provenance === 'object' ? provenance : {};
144   const lines = [];
145   if (Array.isArray(p.userRatified) && p.userRatified.length) {
146     lines.push('USER-RATIFIED records (a need citing one of these is independent):');
147     for (const r of p.userRatified) lines.push(`  - ${String(r).slice(0, 300)}`);
148   }
149   if (Array.isArray(p.records) && p.records.length) {
150     lines.push('RECORDS on file (journals, incidents, prior artifacts):');
151     for (const r of p.records) lines.push(`  - ${String(r).slice(0, 300)}`);
152   }
153   if (Array.isArray(p.proposerWritten) && p.proposerWritten.length) {
154     lines.push('PROPOSER-WRITTEN this effort (NOT independent — a need citing only these cannot earn KEEP):');
155     for (const r of p.proposerWritten) lines.push(`  - ${String(r).slice(0, 300)}`);
156   }
157   return lines.join('\n');
158 }

160 function parseJsonReply(reply) {
161   if (reply && typeof reply === 'object') return reply;
162   const text = String(reply ?? '');
163   const start = text.indexOf('{');
164   const end = text.lastIndexOf('}');
165   if (start < 0 || end <= start) throw new ElegancePassError('elegance pass: the seat returned no JSON object');
166   return JSON.parse(text.slice(start, end + 1));
167 }
168 
169 function coerceVerdicts(raw, elements) {
170   const byId = new Map(elements.map((e) => [e.id, e]));
171   const out = [];
172   const seen = new Set();
173   for (const v of Array.isArray(raw?.verdicts) ? raw.verdicts : []) {
174     const id = String(v?.id ?? '');
175     if (!byId.has(id) || seen.has(id)) continue;
176     seen.add(id);
177     const verdict = VERDICTS.includes(v.verdict) ? v.verdict : 'HOLD';
178     const provenance = PROVENANCE.includes(v.provenance) ? v.provenance : 'none';
179     out.push({
180       id,
181       text: byId.get(id).text,
182       kind: byId.get(id).kind,
183       verdict: (verdict === 'KEEP' && (provenance === 'proposer-written' || provenance === 'none'))
184         ? 'HOLD' : verdict,   // RC-1: a KEEP without an independent need is not a KEEP
185       need: String(v.need ?? '').slice(0, 600),
186       provenance,
187       rc2: String(v.rc2 ?? '').slice(0, 600),
188       trigger: String(v.trigger ?? '').slice(0, 300),
189       needed_because: String(v.needed_because ?? '').slice(0, 300),
190       failing: Array.isArray(v.failing) ? v.failing.map(String).slice(0, 8) : [],
191       downgraded_from_keep: verdict === 'KEEP' && (provenance === 'proposer-written' || provenance === 'none'),
192     });
193   }
194   // an element the seat did not judge is HOLD (named: "not judged"), never silently KEEP
195   for (const e of elements) {
196     if (!seen.has(e.id)) {
197       out.push({ id: e.id, text: e.text, kind: e.kind, verdict: 'HOLD', need: '', provenance: 'none',
198         rc2: '', trigger: 'the catcher did not judge this element — judge it before it is built',
199         needed_because: '', failing: ['not judged'], downgraded_from_keep: false });
200     }
201   }
202   return out;
203 }

205 /**
206  * The CATCHER: the steering seat runs the battery over the enumerated elements.
207  * @param {object} o
208  * @param {Array} o.elements   strings or {id,text,kind,detail}
209  * @param {string} o.northStar
210  * @param {string[]} [o.criteria]
211  * @param {{userRatified?:string[], records?:string[], proposerWritten?:string[]}} [o.provenance]
212  * @param {Function} o.agent   agent(prompt, {role,label,schema}) → object | JSON text
213  * @param {string} [o.context] what is being judged (a plan phase list, a wave's diff, …)
214  */
215 export async function runRabbitCatcher({ elements, northStar, criteria = [], provenance = {}, agent, context = '', label = 'rabbit-catcher', log = () => {} } = {}) {
216   if (typeof agent !== 'function') throw new ElegancePassError('runRabbitCatcher requires an agent() seam');
217   const els = normalizeElements(elements);
218   if (!els.length) return { version: ELEGANCE_PASS_VERSION, verdicts: [], keep: [], hold: [], cut: [], nothingCut: true, stamp: 'no elements' };
219   const prompt = [
220     'You are the STEERING seat running the Elegance pass and the Rabbit-Catcher battery over an enumerated',
221     'list of plan/build elements. Judge each element with the battery below; give exactly one verdict each.',
222     'Cite the INDEPENDENT record that forces the element (RC-1) and tag its provenance honestly. A need that',
223     'exists only because the proposer wrote it for this effort is `proposer-written` and cannot earn KEEP.',
224     'Tests, seams and refactors are malleability work: judge them by the carve-out, never as "unused".',
225     'A guard is judged by RC-G. When uncertain about the critical path (RC-6), HOLD with a one-line question',
226     'for the user — never KEEP by default. Return JSON only, matching the schema.',
227     '',
228     `NORTH STAR:\n${String(northStar || '').slice(0, 6000)}`,
229     criteria.length ? `\nSUCCESS CRITERIA:\n${criteria.map((c, i) => `${i + 1}. ${String(c).slice(0, 500)}`).join('\n')}` : '',
230     provenanceBlock(provenance) ? `\nPROVENANCE:\n${provenanceBlock(provenance)}` : '',
231     context ? `\nWHAT IS BEING JUDGED: ${String(context).slice(0, 400)}` : '',
232     `\nTHE BATTERY:${RC_BATTERY}`,
233     '\nELEMENTS:',
234     ...els.map((e) => `- [${e.id}] (${e.kind}) ${e.text}${e.detail ? `\n    detail: ${e.detail}` : ''}`),
235     '',
236     'Output: {"verdicts":[{"id","verdict":"KEEP|HOLD|CUT","need","provenance":"user-ratified|record|proposer-written|none",',
237     '"rc2","trigger","needed_because","failing":["RC-n",...]}], "nothing_cut_said_aloud": boolean}',
238   ].filter((s) => s !== '').join('\n');
239   const reply = await agent(prompt, { role: 'synthesizer', label, schema: CATCHER_SCHEMA });
240   const verdicts = coerceVerdicts(parseJsonReply(reply), els);
241   const keep = verdicts.filter((v) => v.verdict === 'KEEP').map((v) => v.id);
242   const hold = verdicts.filter((v) => v.verdict === 'HOLD').map((v) => v.id);
243   const cut = verdicts.filter((v) => v.verdict === 'CUT').map((v) => v.id);
244   log(`elegance pass: ${els.length} element(s) → keep ${keep.length} · hold ${hold.length} · cut ${cut.length}` +
245     (cut.length === 0 ? ' · nothing cut (said aloud)' : ''));
246   return { version: ELEGANCE_PASS_VERSION, verdicts, keep, hold, cut, nothingCut: cut.length === 0, stamp: 'catcher' };
247 }
248 
249 /**
250  * The ADVERSARY: the review seat attacks the verdicts. A CUT the adversary refutes is RESTORED to
251  * HOLD (with the adversary's trigger); a KEEP the adversary attacks with BLOCKER/MAJOR severity is
252  * demoted to HOLD; a CUT the adversary confirms (or does not dispute) stays CUT.
253  */
254 export async function runRabbitCatcherAdversary({ catcher, elements, northStar, agent, label = 'rabbit-catcher-adversary', log = () => {} } = {}) {
255   // (2026-09-07, crucible journal 0099) a KEEP whose need is USER-RATIFIED is not the proposer's
256   // own record — the user's lock is the independent need — so a dispute is recorded but moves nothing.
257   const userLocked = (v) => String(v?.provenance || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('user');
258   if (typeof agent !== 'function') throw new ElegancePassError('runRabbitCatcherAdversary requires an agent() seam');
259   const verdicts = Array.isArray(catcher?.verdicts) ? catcher.verdicts : [];
260   if (!verdicts.length) return { disputes: [], verdicts: [], confirmedCuts: [], restored: [], demoted: [] };
261   const prompt = [
262     'You are an independent ADVERSARIAL reviewer (a different model family from the steering seat) attacking',
263     'the verdicts of an Elegance / Rabbit-Catcher pass. Refute what is wrong: a KEEP whose cited need is not',
264     'independent of its proposer (RC-1), a CUT that surrenders a datum or removes malleability work that',
265     'names its next change (RC-2 carve-out), a HOLD with no trigger, a guard kept without a hazard that',
266     'meets the independence law (RC-G). Do not restate agreement; only disputes. Return JSON only.',
267     '',
268     `NORTH STAR:\n${String(northStar || '').slice(0, 4000)}`,
269     `\nTHE BATTERY:${RC_BATTERY}`,
270     '\nVERDICTS UNDER ATTACK:',
271     ...verdicts.map((v) => `- [${v.id}] ${v.verdict} — ${v.text}\n    need: ${v.need || '(none)'} [${v.provenance}]\n    rc2: ${v.rc2 || '(none)'}${v.trigger ? `\n    trigger: ${v.trigger}` : ''}`),
272     '',
273     'Output: {"disputes":[{"id","disputed_verdict":"KEEP|HOLD|CUT","proposed_verdict":"KEEP|HOLD|CUT","reason","severity":"BLOCKER|MAJOR|MINOR","trigger"}]}',
274   ].join('\n');
275   const reply = await agent(prompt, { role: 'shark', label, schema: ADVERSARY_SCHEMA });
276   const raw = parseJsonReply(reply);
277   const byId = new Map(verdicts.map((v) => [v.id, { ...v }]));
278   const disputes = [];
279   const restored = [];
280   const demoted = [];
281   for (const d of Array.isArray(raw?.disputes) ? raw.disputes : []) {
282     const id = String(d?.id ?? '');
283     const v = byId.get(id);
284     if (!v) continue;
285     const severity = ['BLOCKER', 'MAJOR', 'MINOR'].includes(d.severity) ? d.severity : 'MINOR';
286     const dispute = { id, disputed_verdict: v.verdict, proposed_verdict: VERDICTS.includes(d.proposed_verdict) ? d.proposed_verdict : 'HOLD',
287       reason: String(d.reason ?? '').slice(0, 600), severity, trigger: String(d.trigger ?? '').slice(0, 300) };
288     disputes.push(dispute);
289     if (severity === 'MINOR') continue;   // a minor dispute is recorded, it moves nothing
290     if (v.verdict === 'CUT') {
291       v.verdict = 'HOLD'; v.trigger = dispute.trigger || dispute.reason; v.restored_by_adversary = true; restored.push(id);
292     } else if (v.verdict === 'KEEP' && !userLocked(v)) {
293       v.verdict = 'HOLD'; v.trigger = dispute.trigger || dispute.reason; v.demoted_by_adversary = true; demoted.push(id);
294     }
295   }
296   const final = [...byId.values()];
297   const confirmedCuts = final.filter((v) => v.verdict === 'CUT').map((v) => v.id);
298   log(`elegance adversary: ${disputes.length} dispute(s) → ${restored.length} cut(s) restored to HOLD, ${demoted.length} keep(s) demoted to HOLD, ${confirmedCuts.length} cut(s) confirmed`);
299   return { disputes, verdicts: final, confirmedCuts, restored, demoted };
300 }
301 
302 /**
303  * The whole pass: catcher, then adversary. `cuts` are CONFIRMED cuts (the adversary did not
304  * refute them); the engines apply those. Never throws on an empty element list.
305  */
306 export async function runElegancePass({ elements, northStar, criteria, provenance, agent, context, log = () => {}, adversary = true } = {}) {
307   const catcher = await runRabbitCatcher({ elements, northStar, criteria, provenance, agent, context, log });
308   if (!catcher.verdicts.length) {
309     return { ...catcher, cuts: [], holds: [], keeps: [], disputes: [], markdown: renderElegancePass({ verdicts: [], disputes: [], context }) };
310   }
311   let verdicts = catcher.verdicts;
312   let disputes = [];
313   if (adversary) {
314     const adv = await runRabbitCatcherAdversary({ catcher, elements, northStar, agent, log });
315     verdicts = adv.verdicts;
316     disputes = adv.disputes;
317   }
318   const cuts = verdicts.filter((v) => v.verdict === 'CUT').map((v) => v.id);
319   const holds = verdicts.filter((v) => v.verdict === 'HOLD').map((v) => v.id);
320   const keeps = verdicts.filter((v) => v.verdict === 'KEEP').map((v) => v.id);
321   return { version: ELEGANCE_PASS_VERSION, verdicts, disputes, cuts, holds, keeps, nothingCut: cuts.length === 0,
322     markdown: renderElegancePass({ verdicts, disputes, context }) };
323 }
324 
325 /** The human-readable record — the "show a cut" line the Elegance Law demands is generated here. */
326 export function renderElegancePass({ verdicts = [], disputes = [], context = '' } = {}) {
327   const cuts = verdicts.filter((v) => v.verdict === 'CUT');
328   const holds = verdicts.filter((v) => v.verdict === 'HOLD');
329   const keeps = verdicts.filter((v) => v.verdict === 'KEEP');
330   const lines = [
331     `# Elegance pass — Rabbit-Catcher (${ELEGANCE_PASS_VERSION})`,
332     '',
333     context ? `**Judged:** ${context}` : '',
334     `**Verdicts:** keep ${keeps.length} · hold ${holds.length} · cut ${cuts.length} · disputes ${disputes.length}`,
335     cuts.length ? `**Cut:** ${cuts.map((v) => `[${v.id}] ${v.text}`).join('; ')}` : '**Nothing cut** (said aloud).',
336     '',
337     '| id | verdict | element | need (provenance) | delete-and-check | trigger / needed-because |',
338     '|---|---|---|---|---|---|',
339     ...verdicts.map((v) => `| ${v.id} | ${v.verdict}${v.restored_by_adversary ? ' (restored)' : ''}${v.demoted_by_adversary ? ' (demoted)' : ''}${v.downgraded_from_keep ? ' (no independent need)' : ''} | ${cell(v.text)} | ${cell(v.need)} (${v.provenance}) | ${cell(v.rc2)} | ${cell(v.trigger || v.needed_because)} |`),
340   ];
341   if (disputes.length) {
342     lines.push('', '## Adversary disputes', ...disputes.map((d) => `- [${d.id}] ${d.severity}: ${d.disputed_verdict} → ${d.proposed_verdict} — ${d.reason}`));
343   }
344   return lines.filter((l) => l !== '' || true).join('\n') + '\n';
345 }
346 
347 function cell(s) {
348   return String(s ?? '').replace(/\|/g, '\\|').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 220);
349 }
350 
351 const RC6_SCHEMA = {
352   type: 'object',
353   required: ['items'],
354   properties: {
355     items: {
356       type: 'array',
357       items: {
358         type: 'object',
359         required: ['id', 'critical', 'reason'],
360         properties: {
361           id: { type: 'string' },
362           critical: { type: 'boolean' },
363           reason: { type: 'string' },
364         },
365       },
366     },
367   },
368 };
369 
370 /**
371  * RC-6 only — the round-boundary question (ELEGANCE.md Part II: "round boundaries ask only
372  * RC-6"). Over a list of open items (researchPrime blockers, open findings), the steering seat
373  * answers "does the locked North Star FAIL without resolving this, or merely feel less complete?".
374  * Items answered "merely" are PARKED: zero further spend, one line for the user
375  * ("possible rabbit hole: … — pursue or drop?"). One call; skipped when there is nothing open.
376  *
377  * @returns {Promise<{ critical: string[], parked: Array<{id, text, reason}>, lines: string[] }>}
378  */
379 export async function runCriticalPathCheck({ items, northStar, agent, label = 'rc6-critical-path', log = () => {} } = {}) {
380   const list = normalizeElements(items);
381   if (!list.length) return { critical: [], parked: [], lines: [] };
382   if (typeof agent !== 'function') throw new ElegancePassError('runCriticalPathCheck requires an agent() seam');
383   const prompt = [
384     'You are the STEERING seat asking ONE question (RC-6, the critical-path question) about each open item:',
385     'does the locked North Star FAIL without resolving this item, or would the result merely feel less complete?',
386     'Answer critical=true only when the North Star fails without it. A "merely" item is parked, never pursued',
387     'silently. Return JSON only.',
388     '',
389     'NORTH STAR:',
390     String(northStar || '').slice(0, 4000),
391     '',
392     'OPEN ITEMS:',
393     ...list.map((e) => '- [' + e.id + '] ' + e.text),
394     '',
395     'Output: {"items":[{"id","critical":true|false,"reason"}]}',
396   ].join(String.fromCharCode(10));
397   const reply = await agent(prompt, { role: 'synthesizer', label, schema: RC6_SCHEMA });
398   const raw = parseJsonReply(reply);
399   const byId = new Map(list.map((e) => [e.id, e]));
400   const critical = [];
401   const parked = [];
402   const seen = new Set();
403   for (const it of Array.isArray(raw?.items) ? raw.items : []) {
404     const id = String(it?.id ?? '');
405     if (!byId.has(id) || seen.has(id)) continue;
406     seen.add(id);
407     if (it.critical === true) critical.push(id);
408     else parked.push({ id, text: byId.get(id).text, reason: String(it.reason ?? '').slice(0, 300) });
409   }
410   for (const e of list) if (!seen.has(e.id)) critical.push(e.id);   // unjudged stays on the path (never silently parked)
411   const lines = parked.map((p) => 'possible rabbit hole: [' + p.id + '] ' + p.text.slice(0, 120) + ' because ' + (p.reason || 'not on the critical path') + ' — pursue or drop?');
412   log('RC-6: ' + list.length + ' open item(s) → ' + critical.length + ' critical, ' + parked.length + ' parked');
413   return { critical, parked, lines };
414 }
415 
416 
417 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
418 // RC-8 — the wave-count question (John, 2026-09-05: seven emitted waves for three real changes went
419 // through the element battery unchallenged; the battery judged elements, never the wave count).
420 // The steering seat proposes merges of ADJACENT waves that are one change; the adversary (the other
421 // family) disputes; only undisputed merges are applied by the caller. Pure over the reply.
422 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
423 const RC8_SCHEMA = {
424   type: 'object', required: ['merges'],
425   properties: { merges: { type: 'array', items: {
426     type: 'object', required: ['waves', 'reason'],
427     properties: { waves: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'number' } }, reason: { type: 'string' } },
428   } } },
429 };
430 const RC8_DISPUTE_SCHEMA = {
431   type: 'object', required: ['disputes'],
432   properties: { disputes: { type: 'array', items: {
433     type: 'object', required: ['waves', 'severity', 'reason'],
434     properties: { waves: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'number' } }, severity: { enum: ['BLOCKER', 'MAJOR', 'MINOR'] }, reason: { type: 'string' } },
435   } } },
436 };
437 
438 /** A merge is a run of ≥2 distinct, ascending, ADJACENT 1-based wave numbers inside 1..n; runs never overlap (first wins). */
439 export function normalizeWaveMerges(raw, n) {
440   const out = [];
441   const taken = new Set();
442   for (const m of Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : []) {
443     const ws = Array.isArray(m?.waves) ? m.waves.map((x) => Number(x)).filter((x) => Number.isInteger(x)) : [];
444     if (ws.length < 2) continue;
445     const sorted = [...ws].sort((a, b) => a - b);
446     if (sorted[0] < 1 || sorted[sorted.length - 1] > n) continue;
447     let adjacent = true;
448     for (let i = 1; i < sorted.length; i++) if (sorted[i] !== sorted[i - 1] + 1) { adjacent = false; break; }
449     if (!adjacent || sorted.some((w) => taken.has(w))) continue;
450     sorted.forEach((w) => taken.add(w));
451     out.push({ waves: sorted, reason: String(m?.reason ?? '').slice(0, 400) });
452   }
453   return out;
454 }
455 
456 function waveLine(w, i) {
457   const dels = Array.isArray(w?.deliverables) ? w.deliverables.map((d) => String(d ?? '').slice(0, 140)) : [];
458   return '[' + (i + 1) + '] ' + String(w?.title ?? '').slice(0, 160) +
459     (w?.dependsOn ? ' (depends on: ' + String(w.dependsOn).slice(0, 80) + ')' : '') +
460     String.fromCharCode(10) + '    done-when: ' + String(w?.doneWhen ?? '').slice(0, 260) +
461     (dels.length ? String.fromCharCode(10) + dels.map((d) => '    - ' + d).join(String.fromCharCode(10)) : '');
462 }
463 
464 /**
465  * RC-8 over a wave list. Returns `{ merges, confirmed, disputes, lines }` — `confirmed` are the merges
466  * no MAJOR/BLOCKER dispute touched. A list of fewer than two waves asks nothing.
467  */
468 export async function runWaveCountCheck({ waves, northStar, agent, label = 'rc8-wave-count', log = () => {} } = {}) {
469   const list = Array.isArray(waves) ? waves : [];
470   if (list.length < 2) return { merges: [], confirmed: [], disputes: [], lines: [] };
471   if (typeof agent !== 'function') throw new ElegancePassError('runWaveCountCheck requires an agent() seam');
472   const NL = String.fromCharCode(10);
473   const shown = list.map(waveLine).join(NL);
474   const prompt = [
475     'You are the STEERING seat asking ONE question (RC-8, the wave-count question) about a wave decomposition:',
476     'is each wave a change a reviewer would want to see alone? Adjacent waves that are ONE change merge:',
477     'a parser without its renderer is invisible; a module without its hooks is dead code; a backend that',
478     'exists only for one link ships with the link; a wave whose gate needs the NEXT wave\'s change to be',
479     'TESTED is the same change. Do NOT merge waves that touch different failure surfaces, or that would',
480     'bury an irreversible / externally visible step beside a safe one. Name only ADJACENT runs',
481     '([n, n+1] or [n, n+1, n+2]); an empty list means every wave stands alone. Return JSON only.',
482     '',
483     'NORTH STAR:',
484     String(northStar || '').slice(0, 4000),
485     '',
486     'WAVES:',
487     shown,
488     '',
489     'Output: {"merges":[{"waves":[n,m],"reason"}]}',
490   ].join(NL);
491   const reply = await agent(prompt, { role: 'synthesizer', label, schema: RC8_SCHEMA });
492   const merges = normalizeWaveMerges(parseJsonReply(reply)?.merges, list.length);
493   let disputes = [];
494   if (merges.length) {
495     const advPrompt = [
496       'You are an independent ADVERSARIAL reviewer (a different model family from the steering seat) attacking',
497       'proposed MERGES of waves in a decomposition (RC-8, the wave-count question). Refute a merge that would',
498       'combine changes a reviewer must see separately: different failure surfaces; an irreversible or externally',
499       'visible step buried beside a safe one; a wave whose gate is meaningful alone and whose separate GREEN is',
500       'worth having. Do not restate agreement; only disputes. Return JSON only.',
501       '',
502       'NORTH STAR:',
503       String(northStar || '').slice(0, 4000),
504       '',
505       'WAVES:',
506       shown,
507       '',
508       'PROPOSED MERGES:',
509       ...merges.map((m) => '- waves ' + m.waves.join('+') + ' — ' + m.reason),
510       '',
511       'Output: {"disputes":[{"waves":[n,m],"severity":"BLOCKER"|"MAJOR"|"MINOR","reason"}]}',
512     ].join(NL);
513     const advReply = await agent(advPrompt, { role: 'shark', label: label + '-adversary', schema: RC8_DISPUTE_SCHEMA });
514     disputes = (parseJsonReply(advReply)?.disputes ?? []).filter((d) => Array.isArray(d?.waves)).map((d) => ({
515       waves: d.waves.map((x) => Number(x)).filter(Number.isInteger).sort((a, b) => a - b),
516       severity: ['BLOCKER', 'MAJOR', 'MINOR'].includes(d.severity) ? d.severity : 'MINOR',
517       reason: String(d.reason ?? '').slice(0, 400),
518     }));
519   }
520   const blocked = (m) => disputes.some((d) => (d.severity === 'BLOCKER' || d.severity === 'MAJOR') && d.waves.some((w) => m.waves.includes(w)));
521   const confirmed = merges.filter((m) => !blocked(m));
522   const lines = confirmed.map((m) => 'RC-8: merge waves ' + m.waves.join('+') + ' — ' + (m.reason || 'one change'));
523   log('RC-8: ' + list.length + ' wave(s) → ' + merges.length + ' merge(s) proposed, ' + disputes.length + ' dispute(s), ' + confirmed.length + ' confirmed');
524   return { merges, confirmed, disputes, lines };
525 }
